messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 5xx on generation API when hitting quota. Support ticket INC-5432 shows body says 'quota exceeded' but HTTP status is 502/503. Customers expect 429. Seen ~50 incidents in the last hour. Example request-id: rq_9f3a2b. Can SRE confirm?

Jess Ortiz: Customer repro steps pasted below (from support):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"spam"}'
```
Response: 503 Service Unavailable
Body: {"error":"quota_exceeded","msg":"You have exceeded your quota"} 
Headers: `x-request-id: rq_9f3a2b`, `x-proxy-upstream: quota-svc`

Samir Patel: I see similar alerts — spike at 07:42 UTC. Pager shows upstream timeouts to quota-service and gateway returning 502/504. Looking at proxy logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T07:42:13Z] proxy=gw-01 upstream=quota-svc path=/quota/check status=504 duration=15020ms request_id=rq_9f3a2b
[2026-03-15T07:42:13Z] gw-01 -> client: 502 Bad Gateway (mapped from upstream timeout)
```
It appears the quota service or its DB timed out. Instead of mapping the logical `quota_exceeded` to 429, the proxy is bubbling the failure as 5xx because of an upstream timeout or misroute.

Liam Nguyen: FYI I deployed a routing change to the grpc-proxy yesterday (PR #3456) to prefer upstream routing through the new quota-v2 endpoint. Deploy finished ~ 05:10 UTC — deploy-bot log: 
```
deploy-bot: deploy quota-service:v2 to gw-cluster - succeeded 1744997800
```
If quota-v2 falls back to a DB sync that times out, the proxy might not be translating internal error payloads into 4xx. This matches the pattern.

Maya Chen: Customer impact: several paid customers with rate spikes. Support wants beige-level mitigation (429 responses) so clients do backoff instead of immediate re-retries. Next actions?

Samir Patel: Immediate actions: 
- Rollback quota-v2 routing to quota-v1 on gateway to stop misroutes.
- Patch gateway mapping to treat upstream responses with body "quota_exceeded" as 429 when upstream status >=500 and content-type indicates quota error.
- Add a short-term circuit-breaker/local token-bucket so gateway can return 429 if quota-service is unresponsive.
I'm rolling the rollback now. @deploy-bot, trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback quota-service:v2 -> quota-service:v1 initiated by samir at 1745001960

ops-bot: canary in us-east-1 started (10% traffic)

deploy-bot: rollback completed 1745002050 - all gw nodes back to routing -> quota-v1

Jess Ortiz: After rollback support reports mixed results — some customers still see 503s. Repro from same request-id now returns 502 with same body (quota_exceeded).

Samir Patel: Hmm. That suggests the issue isn't only the new route; looks like dependency timeouts to quota DB still ongoing and some requests still routed to backup path that bubbles 5xx. I'm enabling proxy-level mapping now as a hotfix: map any upstream body containing `quota_exceeded` -> 429. Will push rule as config-only change (no service restart).

Liam Nguyen: Patch is ready (config PR #3462). Applying to gw-canary now. Config snippet:
```
if (upstream.status >= 500 && upstream.body.contains("quota_exceeded")) {
  return 429, {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"You have exceeded your quota"}
}
```
Need to be careful to not swallow real upstream outages that should be 5xx. We only map when body explicitly indicates quota.

deploy-bot: applied config PR #3462 to gw-canary at 1745003120

Maya Chen: Support is testing canary — customer reports now getting 429 and client backoff working. Good. Are there telemetry gaps so we missed this earlier?

Samir Patel: Root cause timeline so far: 
1) quota-service v2 route was rolled out -> some traffic hitting quota-v2 which relies on DB sync path that had degraded queries.
2) DB latency spikes caused quota-service responses to time out at proxy, producing 504/502 at gateway.
3) The proxy previously bubbled those timeouts as 5xx; clients saw 5xx despite body saying quota_exceeded in some cases.
4) Rollback helped routing but DB latency persisted causing mixed behavior.
5) Config mapping to 429 reduces client impact while we fix DB and quota service.

Actions & owners: 
- Samir: monitor and hold alert threshold, confirm all regions mapping active (30m) — INC-5432 owner
- Liam: PR to make mapping a proper code-path in proxy (not just config) and add unit tests for mapping logic — PR #3465, ETA EOD
- Jess / Support (Maya): notify affected customers with explanation + mitigation steps and ETA 1hr
- Infra: investigate DB query latency root cause (indexing/replica lag) — ticket INF-2110

Samir Patel: Longer term fixes: 
- Add explicit integration tests that validate HTTP status mapping for upstream quota errors.
- Implement circuit-breaker + local caching token-bucket so gateway can serve 429s when quota backend is unhealthy.
- Alerting: create an alert for count of upstream timeouts to quota-service > 10/min and % of 5xx with quota body > 1%

Maya Chen: Support will hold customers updated and mark incident as "mitigated" once all affected customers see 429s/backoff. Please add runbook steps for detection -> mapping patch -> rollback flow.

Samir Patel: Created incident ticket INC-5432, linked PRs (#3462 config hotfix applied, #3465 code fix in progress), infra ticket INF-2110. Will update with final RCA when DB root cause confirmed.

Jess Ortiz: Thanks everyone — patching messaging to customers now. :thumbsup:

Liam Nguyen: Quick note: after mapping patch, we saw 92% reduction in customer retries/errors within 15m. Will follow-up with perf numbers and PR for permanent mapping.

Maya Chen: Closing notes: owners and follow ups in the thread. If anything else shows up ping @samir or @liam.
